svg.title: mwm2: resize
svg.desc: Holding Left Option, right-dragging the right half of a window moves its right edge, right-dragging the left half moves its left edge, and right-dragging near a corner moves both, stopping at the screen's edge. An outline follows and the window takes its size on release.

g.text: Right-drag. Grab the right half to move the right edge…
…or the left half to move the left edge.
Corners move both. It stays on its screen.
